description.value: Original Pho is a family-run Vietnamese eatery on Fort Street in downtown Victoria, known for long-simmered pho broths layered with toasted spices and grilled proteins finished to order. Nearly every item is made from scratch — herbs and garnishes prepped fresh daily, bowls finished tableside — earning it a loyal local following. Cyclists can dine in or order pickup and delivery from a broad menu spanning pho, vermicelli, rice plates, and iced coffee.
